description: DIN rail power and energy meters AcuRev 1312, 1313 and 1314 (RS485 Modbus RTU)
source: Accuenergy, "AcuRev 1310 Modbus Map" v1.00 and "AcuRev 1310 DIN-Rail Power Meter Users Manual" v1.2.11 (October 2026)

sources.title: AcuRev 1310 DIN-Rail Power Meter Users Manual

notes: AcuRev 1312 (single phase), 1313 (three phase) and 1314 (three phase with neutral CT).
FC03 reads, FC10 writes; values are big endian, high word first. Floats are IEEE 754.
Real-time powers and demands are in kW, kvar and kVA; energies are counts of 0.01 kWh (kvarh, kVAh).
Writing energies, resets and most settings needs the communication revise authority (0x20A) after the password (0x20B).
Date/time stamps of peaks, max/min values and records (3 registers, YY MM DD hh mm ss), the TOU program, alarm settings and event logs are in the manual and not in this map.
The SunSpec common and meter models are also published from 0x1000 and from 50000; see the SunSpec maps for their layout.
